detail: Cyrillic title and long text entered in native UI, saved to list

Native Android Files → Share → Vaulto imported synthetic Russian speech (12.04 seconds). Cloud transcript rendered; Anna, Boris, Friday, 15:00 and 20,000 rubles retained. Inflection позвонить/позвоните differs; completion observed within 24s, not a phone benchmark.
Background download remains at rounded 100% (678/680 MB); speech is ready, AI status not yet confirmed. Do not count as complete.
Native UI shows Ready: speech and AI work without internet. Both models finished; leaving Settings and importing a cloud recording did not cancel download.

Qwen3.5 0.8B produced Russian summary from the synthetic meeting note, preserving names/date/time/budget and conditional launch; observed result within 35s on emulator (not handset speed). Native low-memory killer reclaimed background Android processes during cold model initialization.
Original Summarize and derived Summarize → Summarize both display compact Summarize without distinct ordinals on release 1.0.92; full versions list distinguishes them.
After fix the derived Summarize → Summarize is displayed as Summarize → Summarize 4, and compact tabs use distinct ordinals. Original edits survived the debug update.

Wi-Fi and mobile data disabled: downloaded Whisper Base produced 145 characters from actual synthetic Russian audio. Functional offline ASR works; Anna became адне and Friday became 5ницу, so quality is imperfect.
Search Анна понедельник shows only the matching original note, offline.
Unmatched query hides notes; no stale match.
Custom name Итог → клиенту remains whole on the compact tab instead of being interpreted as generated lineage.
Edited version marker persists across opening another version and reopening the note; original marker stays only in original.
Native comparison screen shows removed/added words for original versus renamed version, including both independent QA markers.
Two existing plaintext Russian recording captions became v3d ciphertext after loading current code on the same Android installation; four newly generated captions on the second AVD were already v3d.
Custom arrow name and independent edited version survived force-stop and full current-code reload.
Deleted a selected version, then used Undo; its tab returned and the Original remained present.
Copy action completed; checking separate note on list next.
List now contains a separate copy of Structure and the source with its unchanged Original.
Real Qwen3.5 0.8B result captured in 57-milk-tasks-result.png: one Buy milk task, no dairy, but invented 2026-10-19 08:00 from source Buy milk. Incoming feedback is not closed.
After entering title/body and waiting 3s without leaving editor: notes 4→4 after force-stop.
After entering title/body and waiting 3s without leaving editor: notes 4→5 after force-stop.
After entering title/body and waiting 3s without leaving editor: notes 5→6 after force-stop.
Untitled body-only draft is present after force-stop and cold restart.
New empty editor → wait3s → Back: note count remains 6. New draft autosave does not create empty notes.

Recording saved offline without a model; app stopped, connectivity restored, app and note reopened. Recording remains without text despite the earlier automatic-recovery promise. Pending IDs are kept only in a component ref.
After offline share, saved queued metadata, force-stopped app, restored network, reopened note. Actual cloud transcription filled 149 characters; queue acknowledged and removed.
Reopening the completed note does not insert the transcription twice.
Force-stopped during cloud ASR. Note count 2→2. New recording lacks a durable note/recording entry until ASR completes.

Force-stopped while Transcribing visible: the added recording, encrypted file, parent note and pending ID are durable. ASR has not saved a transcript yet. This import appended to the already open note.
Opening the parent note after force-stop re-runs actual cloud ASR, saves an encrypted transcript and acknowledges its queue entry. Recording metadata was durable before ASR.
Transcribing was visible. Note, encrypted audio, metadata and pending identifier survive force-stop before transcript exists.
After force-stop during ASR of a NEW note (count3→4), reopen its audio-only tile: real cloud ASR fills text, v3d encrypted caption, queue cleared.
A second audio Share while the old editor is open now creates a separate note instead of appending to the old one.
Android microphone prompt is shown; denial returns a permission explanation rather than starting a recording.
After denying then granting Android permission: recorder starts, paused elapsed time stays fixed, resume returns to recording controls. Emulator input is silence, so this is a control test only.
Actual exported Markdown file from rich note strips checkbox states and bold; filename/body also have trailing spaces. Read native app file.

Actual cached .md preserves source unchecked/checked tasks, **Сумма**, Unicode, #qa and final newline. Filename has no trailing space. Share sheet opened, no recipient chosen. Visual source also inspected directly; WebView checked flags are unreliable for UI automation.
Restored from Trash, native Raw Markdown confirms unchecked/checked task states, bold amount and tag intact.
